messages:
julie: Heads-up — launching a 2-week opt-in dry run for enriched audit events that include non-secret KMS metadata (key_id, key_fingerprint hash) and extra RBAC decision fields. Goal: validate schema, customer privacy concerns, and SIEM mappings before GA. PMs & sales please prep comms. :loudspeaker:

mike: Quick Q — will this ever include plaintext key material or private key data?

julie: No. Only identifiers and hashes (sha256 fingerprint), region, and algorithm strings. Legal reviewed scope.

alex: How are we versioning this in the event payload? Backward compatibility plan?

sara: We'll publish schema v2.3. Events carry "audit_schema_version":"v2.3". Default remains v2.2 until customers opt in. 3-month deprecation window for older parsers.

mike: Can you post a minimal sample payload for SIEM teams?

sara: Sure — sample below (opt-in only):
```
{
  "audit_schema_version":"v2.3",
  "event_type":"kms.encrypt",
  "actor":"service-account:ingest-svc",
  "resource":"dataset:9876",
  "rbac":{ "decision":"allow", "policy_version":"2026-04-01", "decision_id":"dec-0a1b2c" },
  "kms":{ "key_id":"projects/prod/keys/rdw-01", "key_fingerprint":"sha256:3f5e...9cbb", "region":"us-west-2", "algo":"AES-GCM" }
}
```

dan: Note: for dashboards we should truncate the fingerprint to first 12 chars in UI to reduce accidental leaks. Keep full hash in audit store for verification.

sara: Agreed. UI: truncated. Stored events: full sha256. Storage is encrypted at rest.

julie: Rollout plan & gating?

sec-bot: Rollout plan: flag ff:audit_kms_enrich. Stages: internal -> invited beta customers (opt-in) -> wider opt-in pool. Canary at 2% traffic for 24h, then 10% for 72h. Dry-run S3 bucket: s3://audit-enriched-dryrun/ (14d retention).

mike: We should confirm this is opt-in for customers (explicit) and not opt-out.

julie: Correct — opt-in only. Defaults false until GA. Sales to collect early opt-ins and contract addenda for Private.

angela-support: Support action: prepare KB with example Splunk/Seq parsers,SIEM mapping table, and sample alert rules. Also draft customer FAQ covering privacy and retention.

alex: Also: adding decision_id and policy_version increases event cardinality. Do we have quotas or rate-limits for high-throughput tenants?

sara: We'll emit decision_id only for allow/deny RBAC events and sample/limit on high-throughput paths. Batching + prefix cache helps reduce per-token overhead.

julie: Security — please run a short threat model. Any new exposure from fingerprint hashes?

vuln-team: We'll review. Initial take: sha256 fingerprint alone is non-secret but treat as PII in some customers; recommend access controls on audit S3 and RBAC for audit viewer roles.

mike: Assigning vuln review to me. I'll coordinate with vuln-team and privacy.

julie: Docs needed: changelog entry, sample payloads, migration guide, API header for opt-in (X-Audit-Schema: v2.3), privacy FAQ, and customer email template. I'll draft and circulate.

sara: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/infra/audit-schemas/pull/4823 — includes schema diff and validation tests.

angela-support: Email template and KB draft copied to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Audit-KMS-Enrich/Comm-Draft.docx

julie: Timeline proposal: docs draft by Thu (3 days), internal dry-run Wk of Apr 6, beta invites Wk of Apr 20, GA end of May. If legal or infra blocks emerge we adjust.

dan: Timeline tight but achievable. I'll allocate infra cycles for throttles and retention checks.

julie: Action items: julie -> draft customer-facing changelog & email; sara -> finalize schema PR & tests; mike -> vuln review & privacy check; dan -> runtime throttles + retention; angela-support -> KB & SIEM mappings; sec-bot -> rollout schedule. Reconvene Friday for status.

sec-bot: Note: when FF=true, pipeline will also emit duplicate events to the dryrun bucket for 14 days. Ensure audit S3 lifecycle & encryption policies are correct.

mike: Flagged retention and access controls to privacy/legal.

julie: Thanks everyone. Once PR merges I'll publish the customer-facing announcement and changelog. We'll keep this opt-in and reversible. :white_check_mark:
